info.name: MAYA Backend Product Flow
info.description:
Session-cookie API flow for the current Flask backend (not JWT).

Use collection variables. After Login, Postman must keep the `session` cookie.

Final E2E order: Health → Register → Login → Me → Create Case → List/Get Case → Upload Evidence (form field `file`) → Get Evidence → Verify Integrity → Analyze → Get Analysis → Generate PDF → Download PDF → Audit.

Envelope: `{ok, data, message?}` on success; `{ok:false, error, message}` on failure.

request.description:
Auth: none.
Expected 200.
Fields: status=ok, service=maya, phase=1.

Auth: public if ALLOW_PUBLIC_REGISTRATION=true.
JSON: email, username, password, full_name?
Expected 201 (409 if username/email already exists).
Fields: data.id, data.email, data.username, data.role (INVESTIGATOR).

Auth: public.
JSON: login (username or email) OR email/username, plus password.
Expected 200 + Set-Cookie `session` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax).
Keep cookies for all later requests.
Fields: data.id, data.username, data.role.

Auth: session required.
Expected 200 (401 if not logged in).
Fields: data.id, data.email, data.username, data.role, data.is_active.

Auth: session required.
JSON: title (required), description?, priority? LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH.
Expected 201.
Fields: data.case_id, data.case_number (CASE-YYYY-######), data.status=OPEN, data.priority.

Auth: session required.
Expected 200 array in data. INVESTIGATOR sees own cases; ADMIN sees all.

Auth: session + ownership.
Expected 200 (403/404 otherwise).
Fields: data.case_id, data.case_number, data.title, data.status.

formdata.description: Required multipart field name is `file`. PNG/JPEG/BMP/WEBP, max 16MB. Select a small RGB image in Postman. Optional: set collection variable evidence_file to a local path.

request.description:
Auth: session + case ownership.
Content-Type: multipart/form-data.
Field `file` (required): image .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.bmp/.webp.
Field `notes` (optional).
Expected 201.
Fields: data.evidence_id, data.sha256 (server SHA-256, 64 hex), data.stored_filename (UUID), data.mime_type, data.file_size, data.status=UPLOADED.
Client-supplied hashes are ignored.

Auth: session + ownership.
Expected 200.
Fields: data.evidence_id, data.sha256, data.storage_path, data.analysis_status.

Auth: session + ownership.
No required body.
Expected 200.
Fields: data.stored_sha256, data.current_sha256, data.integrity_status (VALID|MODIFIED|MISSING|ERROR).

Auth: session + ownership.
JSON optional: generate_explanation (default true), explainer (default gradcam), verify_before_analyze (default true), explainers[], advanced_xai {shap,faithfulness,counterfactual,fusion,trust,multi_explainer}.
Expected 201. This call runs real EfficientNet-B0 inference; Grad-CAM adds several seconds on CPU.
Do not enable advanced_xai SHAP/fusion in Postman unless you can wait (CPU-heavy).
Fields: data.analysis_id, data.investigation_id (INV-…), data.prediction REAL|FAKE, data.confidence, data.analysis_status, data.artifact_dir, data.explanation.{heatmap,overlay,explanation_json}.

Auth: session + ownership.
Expected 200.
Alias also exists: GET /api/investigations/{{analysis_id}}.
Fields: same AnalysisRun object as analyze response.

Auth: session + analysis ownership. Analysis must be COMPLETED.
JSON: investigator_notes?, format? (pdf).
Expected 201.
Fields: data.report_id, data.report_number (RPT-YYYY-######), data.sha256, data.storage_path, data.investigation_id, data.size_bytes.

Auth: session + ownership.
Expected 200 application/pdf attachment.
Related: GET /api/reports/{{report_id}} (metadata JSON), GET /api/analysis/{{analysis_id}}/reports (list).

Auth: session required. ADMIN sees all; INVESTIGATOR sees own events only. Limit 200.
Expected 200 array.
Fields per row: audit_id, user_id, case_id, evidence_id, analysis_id, event_type, timestamp, details.
Typical types in this flow: USER_REGISTERED, USER_LOGIN, CASE_CREATED, EVIDENCE_UPLOADED, EVIDENCE_VERIFIED, ANALYSIS_STARTED, XAI_GENERATED, ANALYSIS_COMPLETED, REPORT_GENERATED.
Auth: owner or admin. JSON: title?, description?, status?, priority?. Cannot modify ARCHIVED cases. Expected 200.
Auth: owner or admin. Sets status=CLOSED. Run after the PDF download if you still need an OPEN case for other requests. Expected 200.
Auth: session required. Expected 200 {ok:true, message: Logged out}. Subsequent /me is 401.
